name: documents-saved-in-notes
description: Documents beside the chat: asked for in the notes or a Markdown file, the document is made and the answer says where it is (a document is a Markdown note in Notes, Chat documents), never that it can't write to the notes or a file; asked again, the same, and no note made for it (Claude Haiku 5.5 made the document, then said it couldn't write to the notes or a Markdown file, 30 Oct 2026).
